summary: GDS Holdings filed a Form 6-K with exhibits announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held on June 25, 2026, in Shanghai. The filing includes the notice of AGM, proxy statement, and proxy card. Holders of ordinary shares and convertible preferred shares as of June 4, 2026, are entitled to vote; ADS holders must instruct JPMorgan Chase, the depositary. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation or corporate action event. No deal terms, price, premium, or strategic changes are involved.
